title: Hi, I’m Jacob!
text:
Hi, I’m Jacob!





I’m a physicist and engineer who builds scientific software and hardware. I have an undergraduate degree in Applied Physics from Columbia.
Most recently, I was a Research Assistant at NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, where I developed the data-processing pipeline for a space telescope. Before that, I spent two years in an optics lab at the University of Arizona, leading the software and hardware upgrade of a robotic telescope.
Check out my projects to see more of my work.
